name: Audit CLI command surface and decouple synth.js
goal: INVESTIGATION. Survey every CLI verb/subcommand (mission, expedition, evidence, validate, explain, docs, bootstrap, etc.) and quantify redundancy: overlapping procedures that can collapse into a smaller, memorable command set, reducing the operator 'knowledge quorum'. Map findings against existing related expeditions so the audit extends rather than duplicates them: bc9c51e0 (termination-model unification), dac069e8 (lifecycle simplification), ceaa59bf (bootstrap-performance). Identify where synth.js loads the full machinery (13-step bootstrap, all adapters, Mission Studio, Planning Cognition) on every invocation, and propose decoupling: lazy/deferred per-command loading, command-group entry points, and a thinner default path. Deliverable: a written audit plus follow-up expedition drafts minted from concrete findings (e.g. verb consolidation, lazy CLI loader).
